Having more then 3 years of experience. 

This is my first company , started my career with this l, started in sept 2022

masai school to tracxn senior engineer in 3 years... that's actually impressive. most bootcamp grads hop around like crazy but you stuck it out and got promoted. either tracxn treats you really well or you're comfortable... maybe too comfortable?

what kind of role you looking for next?

I am looking for change..

As a full stack developer mern stack or a frontend role

full stack mern or frontend... makes sense. 3 years backend at tracxn, now you want to touch the user-facing stuff. react, node, the whole shebang.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Itno i am working as full stack developer not as backend, its a mern stack role
